//Urls: Loopback only: the phones reach the API through `tailscale serve --bg 5080`, which adds HTTPS and the caller's identity. Do not open it on the LAN.

Database.//: The same database as the workstations: copy the ConnectionString of their appsettings.json. The account the service runs as must be able to sign in to SQL Server with it.

MobileApi.//MaxSessionLifetime: The longest a phone stays signed in, however active. The idle timeout is the password policy's.
MobileApi.//DefaultLanguage: Language of a refusal answered before sign-in when the phone asks for none of French, Arabic, English.

PasswordPolicy.//: Keep identical to the workstations' appsettings.json: the lockout counts and the idle timeout are one policy.

Reporting.//: Keep identical to the workstations': a report issued from a phone is the same document. See src/MarocLIS.Reporting/LICENSING.md before setting the licence.
